name: conveyor-lead
summary: Conveyor intake lead - receives work, keeps station handoffs clear, and closes packets

name: code-review
summary: Dual independent reviewers with an orchestrator. Each reviewer analyzes the code independently, then the orchestrator synthesizes their findings. Disagreements surface real issues.

name: secrets-manager
summary: HashiCorp Vault in dev mode with a dedicated Vault specialist agent. Vault boots before the specialist launches, health is gated, and the env receipt is captured. The specialist can read, write, list, and delete secrets via the Vault HTTP API.

name: basic-loop
summary: Walk one work packet through the conveyor rig slowly enough for a new user to inspect each handoff.
